UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user sync profile storing cross-device Google Sheets linkage for an authenticated trading tracker account.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

spreadsheetId.description: Linked Google Spreadsheet ID synced across devices (empty string if unconnected).

spreadsheetTitle.description: Display title of the linked Google Spreadsheet.

spreadsheetUrl.description: Direct HTTPS URL to the linked Google Spreadsheet.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user sync profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user sync profile was last updated.

TradeEntry.title: TradeEntry
TradeEntry.description: Personal trading profit record storing the user's 50% profit share directly and optional capital used.

id.description: Unique trade record identifier matching the document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the trade record owner.

tradeDate.description: Trade date stored consistently as YYYY-MM-DD.

myProfit.description: User's net 50% profit share in INR (never divided by 2).

capitalUsed.description: Optional capital used in INR (null if not recorded; never treated as zero when missing).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the trade record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the trade record was last modified.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only sync profile document storing the authenticated user's linked Google Spreadsheet metadata.

/users/{userId}/trades/{tradeId}.description: Owner-only subcollection of trading profit entries synced in real time across mobile and desktop for the signed-in Google account.
